rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides a discovery and execution layer for x402-compatible agent APIs on Base mainnet. Agents can search a live catalog of endpoints ranked by price, trust score, and latency, then purchase routes or inspect providers before spending. Includes tools for wallet intelligence materialization, session-based discovery workflows, marketplace agent registration, and proposal composition. Supports both discovery-only and paid execution modes.
